name: Bird

nadir.desc: The property consists of a long single-story residence with a light-colored metal roof|A smaller outbuilding is located nearby|The lot is primarily open dirt and grass with scattered vegetation|Dense mature trees surround the property on multiple sides|A dirt driveway provides access from the road.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a long single-story structure with a light metal roof facing the road|A dirt driveway leads from the street to the house|Open ground with scattered vegetation and dead trees surrounds the front of the property|Dense trees form a backdrop behind the structures.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence is heavily screened by dense mature trees|Portions of the light-colored roof and structure are visible through the canopy|Open ground and vegetation are limited on this side.

charlie.desc: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front and side of the residence, with space for vehicle staging|The front of the property is open and clearly accessible|Mature trees and dense landscaping surround much of the house and may limit visibility and movement in some areas|Open lawn and garden spaces provide additional room near the structure|The property is located in a semi-rural residential setting with road access.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the long single-story structure and the dirt driveway approaching from the road|Open ground with scattered vegetation surrounds this side|Dense trees border the property edge.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a dirt driveway that leads from the road to the front of the residence. The front of the property is open and accessible from the street. Dense mature trees surround much of the lot and limit visibility and movement on the sides and rear. Open dirt and grass areas near the house provide space for emergency vehicle staging. The property is located in a rural wooded setting.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle or pedestrian access available around all sides of the residence and outbuilding? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery due to tree cover? How dense is the tree coverage for emergency vehicle and personnel movement around the full perimeter of the structures?
